exactTest: RC-1 bounded native disk monitoring bounds traversal depth rather than accumulating an unbounded path list

exactTest: RC-1 bounded native disk monitoring continues to enforce timeout and output caps

exactTest: RC-1 bounded native disk monitoring does not classify permission failure as a measured disk overflow
assertion: Injected EACCES fails closed as NATIVE_WORKSPACE_UNAVAILABLE in traversal and actual child execution, never disk overflow.

exactTest: RC-1 bounded native disk monitoring never invokes a shell and retains command/arguments as separate argv entries
assertion: Outer guard launch preserves argument boundaries and shell:false; guard implementation remains unchanged and shell:false.

exactTest: RC-1 bounded native disk monitoring rejects escaping and nested escaping links while allowing internal package-manager links
assertion: Internal package links are allowed; direct and chained links outside the workspace are refused.

exactTest: RC-1 bounded native disk monitoring runs concurrent create/delete and rename churn without a false NATIVE_DISK_LIMIT
assertion: Real argv child repeatedly creates, renames and deletes files across monitor ticks and exits successfully; event-loop timer remains responsive.

exactTest: RC-1 bounded native disk monitoring still terminates a real measured workspace byte-cap violation
assertion: Real child writes over its configured test byte cap and is terminated with NATIVE_DISK_LIMIT; production caps unchanged.

exactTest: RC-1 bounded native disk monitoring tolerates a directory removed while traversal is opening it

exactTest: RC-1 bounded native disk monitoring tolerates an actual transient ENOENT between directory enumeration and lstat
assertion: Delete a real file between enumeration and stat; traversal completes without NATIVE_DISK_LIMIT.
